column1: # Portal target fixes for the server WZ XML (host data, not in git). Apply with:
#   python3 tools/data-align/wz_set_values.py --wz <server wz dir> --tsv tools/data-align/portal-fixes.tsv --column new_value [--apply]
# Each row only applies while the file still holds server_value. Restart the server afterwards.
# 271010400 north00 -> 271010500 tn west00: 271010500 has no west00 (portals sp, out00, goPerion, in00),
# so players land at sp (GenericPortal falls back to portal 0). out00 is the portal on 271010500 that leads back to 271010400 (alignment audit, 1.4.1).
# Bots: GCWorldGraph keeps only tm (map adjacency) and BotNavigationGraphProvider only follows tn for
# same-map portals, so routing does not depend on this tn. GCPortals warps bots through it with the same
# portal-0 fallback as players, so today bots also arrive at sp; after the fix both arrive at out00.

column5: north00 -> 271010500: west00 does not exist there
